observedCapabilities: --cpu-prof starts V8 profiling at startup and writes before exit
localHelp.standing: Help was read first. No test or profiler executed.

versionSpecificPrimarySources.finding: Default isolated test-file processes inherit Node options except the documented test/watch/config/reporter exclusions; cpu-prof options are not excluded.
kFilterArgs/kFilterArgValues and getRunArgs preserve profiler options; runTestFile spawns process.execPath with those arguments and the child test context.
Default output filename includes timestamp, process ID, thread ID and sequence. Leave name unset to avoid collision; writing occurs before process exit.

existingProfiler.finding: Uses inspector.Session in the measuring process around a chosen call. Reusing that injection here would alter the unchanged test or add a preload. Prefer documented CLI profiler flags for this diagnostic; existing command/file-host/reporter owners remain.

scopeLimit: This verifies documented option propagation to the isolated test process, not arbitrary fixture subprocesses or all threads. Actual profile PID/TID files must be matched to observed ownership. A killed process may leave no usable profile.
